selection: Same six frozen files (five families), used in development; integration regression, not held-out recognition accuracy.

circular_boundary_crosscheck.measurement: Planar inner-wire length / pi and linear centroid, same OCCT kernel

slot_boundary_crosscheck.method: Integrated arc lengths / pi, straight-edge lengths, wire centroids and centroid separation
